text: DBS: we noticed unusual activity on your card ending 4321. If this was not you, call the number printed on the back of your card. We will never ask for your PIN, password or OTP.
rationale: A bank's own fraud alert that tells the worker not to share codes; sends them to the card's own number.

text: Your transfer of 500 SGD to India was delivered on 4 Nov. Reference TR120045. Questions? Open the app, tap Help. We never ask for your login or a code by message.
rationale: A remittance receipt asks for nothing and warns against sharing codes.

text: Hi, HR here. Your October salary of 2,800 SGD will be paid on the 28th into your bank account on file. If the account has changed, tell your supervisor in person.
rationale: A payroll notice that asks for no payment and sends changes to a face-to-face check.

text: Reminder: your interview at Bright Path Employment is on Tuesday at 10 am, Level 3. Bring your passport to show at the counter. No fee is charged at any stage. Details: https://brightpath-hire.example/interview
rationale: An agency interview reminder that says no fee and links to a reserved example address.

text: MOM: your work pass renewal has been approved. Collect the new card from your employer. No payment is required from you. Check the status yourself at the official MOM website.
rationale: An official approval that asks for nothing and tells the worker to check on the official site.

text: Reminder from your licensed lender: your instalment of 150 SGD is due on the 5th. Pay in your bank app or at our office. The late fee is in your agreement.
rationale: A due-date reminder from a lender the worker already has; no link, no new request.

text: Hey, can you lend me 50 SGD until Friday? I will send it back by PayNow on payday. My phone battery is dying, so call me tonight.
rationale: A friend asking to borrow a small amount; no pressure, no link, no code.

text: Staff dinner raffle: names are drawn this Friday at 6 pm in the canteen. No payment or sign-up is needed. Good luck, everyone!
rationale: A workplace raffle that asks for nothing.

text: Your fixed deposit of 3,000 SGD matures on 12 November at 2.5% a year. Renew or withdraw in the app or at a branch. We will never ask you to move money to another account.
rationale: A bank's own maturity notice that says it never asks for a transfer.

text: Embassy notice: you do not have to pay a recruitment agent more than the legal fee. If you were charged more, report it on the hotline +65 0000 0002. This message is free.
rationale: A government warning against overcharging; asks for no money.

text: Your Grab ride is arriving in 3 minutes. Driver Ahmad, white Toyota SGX0000A. If you did not book this ride, ignore this message.
rationale: A ride notice that asks for nothing.

text: आपका OTP 482913 है। यह 5 मिनट के लिए मान्य है। इसे किसी को न बताएं, बैंक के कर्मचारी को भी नहीं।
rationale: A genuine one-time password message that warns not to share it.

text: नमस्ते, आपकी अक्टूबर की तनख्वाह 2,800 SGD 28 तारीख को आपके बैंक खाते में आ जाएगी। खाता बदला हो तो सुपरवाइज़र को सामने बताएं।
rationale: A payroll notice that asks for nothing.

text: एजेंसी की ओर से सूचना: इस नौकरी के लिए कानून के अनुसार आपको कोई भर्ती शुल्क नहीं देना है। कोई पैसे माँगे तो हमारी हॉटलाइन +65 0000 0003 पर बताएं।
rationale: An agency saying no fee is due and giving a hotline.

text: याद दिलाना: आपकी लाइसेंस प्राप्त ऋणदाता कंपनी की 150 SGD की किस्त 5 तारीख को है। बैंक ऐप से या हमारे ऑफिस में भरें।
rationale: A due-date reminder from an existing lender.

text: Bhai, ghar ke liye 200 SGD bhejne hain. Tu kaunsa app use karta hai? Rate check karna hai, kal shaam ko milte hain.
rationale: A friend asking which remittance app to use; asks for nothing.

text: Good afternoon, we have a caregiver placement in Perth for you. A refundable deposit of 600 AUD secures your place and is returned after your first salary. Please transfer it to account 0000-0000-5678.
rationale: A polite fee request called a refundable deposit before any job exists.

text: Hi, we met at the Sunday market last week. I help workers grow their savings safely with a licensed app and there is no risk. Can I send you the link, https://savewise-app.example ?
rationale: A friendly opener that leads toward an investment app; no payment asked yet.

text: Salary advance for workers: up to 1,500 SGD today, no paperwork. Install https://advance-now.example. We need access to your contacts and photos to verify you.
rationale: A quick loan app that asks for contacts and photos, the loan-app trap.

text: Immigration Department: your passport details need verification. Please reply with a photo of your passport and work permit to this number.
rationale: An official-sounding message that asks for ID documents by reply.

text: Hello, this is support from QuickSend. We refunded 40 AUD to your account by mistake. Please read us the 6-digit code you just received so we can reverse it.
rationale: A calm call-style request for a one-time code under a refund story.

text: You are one of 10 workers selected for a free phone giveaway sponsored by your telco. Reply YES to get your claim code.
rationale: A prize message that asks for nothing yet.

text: We are hiring cleaners for the airport, 3,200 SGD a month. Send your name, passport number and a selfie holding your passport to apply on WhatsApp +65 0000 0044.
rationale: A job offer that collects passport details and a selfie.

text: Your parcel is held at customs. Pay 9.90 SGD handling at https://post-customs.example to release it.
rationale: A small fee for a parcel at a fake customs page; fits no other type.

text: Hi, it is your supervisor. I changed my bank. Please send this month's agent fee of 300 SGD to my new account 0000-0000-8899. Delete this message after.
rationale: Pretends to be the supervisor, someone the worker knows, and asks for money and secrecy.

text: नमस्ते, हमारे पास सिंगापुर में केयरगिवर की जगह है। सीट पक्की करने के लिए 500 SGD रिफंडेबल डिपॉज़िट खाता 0000-0000-5678 में भेजें।
rationale: A refundable deposit asked before a job exists.

text: मैं आपके बैंक से बोल रहा हूँ। आपके खाते में गलती से पैसे आ गए हैं। कृपया अभी आया 6 अंकों का कोड बताएं ताकि हम वापस कर सकें।
rationale: A bank-staff story that asks for a one-time code.

text: Aapka 5000 INR ka loan approve ho gaya. App install karo https://quick-loan-hi.example. Contacts aur gallery ka access dena padega.
rationale: A loan app that needs contacts and gallery access.

text: नमस्ते, मैं मनीला से अन्ना हूँ। मेरे अंकल की क्रिप्टो कंपनी में 500 AUD लगाने पर हफ्ते में दोगुना मिलता है। आप भी जुड़िए।
rationale: A new contact who pushes a doubling crypto scheme.

text: बधाई! आपका नंबर कंपनी के मासिक ड्रा में चुना गया है। इनाम पाने के लिए 300 INR प्रोसेसिंग फीस भेजें।
rationale: A prize that needs a processing fee first.
